$comment: Ground truth for scripts/benchmark.ts. StepForge itself must NEVER read this file; only the benchmark compares its findings against it, after the runs. 'detectedBy' names the demo-workspace scenario expected to catch the bug, 'run' the run it shows up in (mobile = the mobile-viewport run of scenarios tagged 'mobile'), and 'acceptableDiagnoses' the diagnosis categories that count as a correct diagnosis. All fields were written before the first benchmark run.

bugs.title: Doctor fee is returned as a string
bugs.expected: fee is a number (OpenAPI: type number)
bugs.actual: fee is a string such as "60.00"

bugs.title: Appointments can be listed without logging in
bugs.expected: 401 without a token (OpenAPI: bearerAuth required)

bugs.title: Deleting an unknown patient returns 204
bugs.expected: 404 for an id that does not exist

bugs.title: Deleting a patient leaves their appointments behind
bugs.expected: The patient's appointments are deleted with the patient (documented in the OpenAPI description)
bugs.actual: Appointments keep pointing at the deleted patient id; appointments.patient_id has no foreign key
bugs.detectedBy: Deleting a patient removes their appointments

bugs.title: The same patient can be registered twice
bugs.expected: 409 when a patient with the same full name and date of birth exists
bugs.actual: A second patients row is created with a new code
bugs.detectedBy: The same patient cannot be registered twice

bugs.title: The upcoming-appointments KPI is labelled "Cancelled appointments"
bugs.expected: "Upcoming appointments"

bugs.title: The Book button cannot be clicked on mobile
bugs.expected: The booking form is usable on a phone
bugs.actual: An "install our app" sheet covers the page and cannot be dismissed
bugs.detectedBy: Book an appointment on a phone

bugs.title: The next-appointments widget throws a TypeError
bugs.expected: The next three appointments are listed
bugs.actual: The list stays at "Loading…" (a.patient is undefined)

bugs.title: The verification email links to /verfy
bugs.expected: A link to /verify that verifies the account
bugs.detectedBy: Verify with the link in the email

bugs.title: The bill ignores insurance
bugs.expected: 20% discount for patients with an insurance provider

bugs.title: The booking form allows double-booking a doctor
bugs.expected: "This doctor is already booked at that time"
bugs.detectedBy: The booking form refuses a double booking

bugs.title: The visits report takes about 1.5 s
bugs.expected: Answers in well under a second

bugs.title: The doctors' schedule runs one query per row (N+1)
bugs.expected: One query (join)
bugs.actual: One query per doctor and per appointment

bugs.title: Products with no stock are shown as "In stock"
bugs.expected: "Out of stock"

bugs.title: "Complete sale" cannot be clicked on mobile
bugs.expected: The point of sale works on a phone
bugs.actual: A "rate us" sheet covers the page and cannot be dismissed
bugs.detectedBy: Complete a sale on a phone

bugs.title: The cart total throws a TypeError
bugs.expected: The running total (quantity × price)
bugs.detectedBy: The cart shows the running total

bugs.title: A product without a name is accepted with 200
bugs.expected: 422 (name is required)
bugs.detectedBy: A product without a name is rejected

bugs.title: Prices are strings
bugs.expected: price and cost are numbers

bugs.title: The profit report is public
bugs.expected: 401 without a token (admins only)
bugs.detectedBy: The profit report requires a login

bugs.title: Stock can go negative
bugs.expected: Selling more than is in stock is refused; stock ≥ 0
bugs.actual: The sale is accepted and stock goes below 0

bugs.title: Deleting a product leaves its sale lines behind
bugs.expected: Sale lines are removed with the product (documented)
bugs.actual: sale_items rows point at a deleted product
bugs.detectedBy: Deleting a product removes its sale lines

bugs.title: Profit is always 0
bugs.expected: profit = revenue − quantity × unit cost
bugs.actual: Cost of goods uses the selling price

bugs.title: The sale total ignores the quantity
bugs.expected: Sum of quantity × price
bugs.detectedBy: A sale total counts every unit

bugs.title: The sales report takes about 1.5 s
bugs.expected: Answers in well under a second

bugs.title: Expanded sales run one query per row (N+1)
bugs.expected: One query (join)
bugs.actual: One query per sale and per line
